0022600169.text: The Trail Blazers (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) visit the Nuggets (3-2, 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back, 8th in the West) for Portland's sixth game of the season, with Portland 3-0 on the road and riding a W1 streak after a 4-1 last ten. Portland will be without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on April 6, 2026, in Denver, when the Trail Blazers lost 137-132; the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
